【June WEB Seminar】Boost efficiency and sales! Getting started with AI

Instructor: Akira Chikuma (Small Business Management Consultant, President and CEO of Childpiece Inc.)

Seminar content: Learn how to use generative AI like ChatGPT. The instructor is a "business mentor to managers" with 17 years of hands-on experience running a cram school and expertise in small-business consulting—including revenue growth, problem-solving, and business analysis. He also specializes in video marketing and website improvement support.

How to watch: Online. On a PC, click the QR code; on a smartphone, scan the QR code.

Who can attend: Member businesses of the Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry

How to apply: This is a member benefit. If you would like ID and password to watch, please contact your representative.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2636/
